newsitem.title: USA: ITT Barton to pay $262,500 to settle U.S. claims.
newsitem.headline: ITT Barton to pay $262,500 to settle U.S. claims.

text.p: The Justice Department said ITT Barton, a unit of ITT Industries, will pay the federal government $262,500 to settle claims it failed to perform required tests on equipment it made for the U.S. Navy.

The equipment measures the level of water, sanitary waste and other liquids in holding tanks on submarines. ITT Barton informed the Defense Department it failed to perform the tests between 1988 and May, 1993 in order to save production time.
